system.description:
[Cancel(Cold):20]。[Trigger: Text] Use this in the Attack Declaration Step when you are selected as a target of an attack with "Target: Wide Area, Straight Line". You may immediately perform a [Instant Move] of 1Sq. After this movement, you may redo the Attack Declaration Step. Once per scene. A multifunctional boot developed by a certain alchemist. It contains various functions such as a heating mechanism for cold resistance, rollers for enabling high-speed movement, and a jump rocket for sudden evasion.

Strange Fossil[Core Material](380G)+Leg Guard(390G)+[Magic Catalyst 14](190G)×3+Crafting Cost(690G)
